title: One normalized, filtered public job per row
description: Only saved jobs appear here. Failures, filtering, empty feeds and incomplete coverage are in diagnostics. Company is a board slug, not a guessed legal company name.

jobKey.title: Stable repeat-run key
jobKey.description: provider:board:sourceId; use in knownJobIds to skip already-saved jobs.

company.title: Company board slug
company.description: The supplied employer board slug; not a guessed display name.

companyDisplayName.title: Employer display name
companyDisplayName.description: Editorial catalog name for recognized boards; board slug otherwise. Not a verified legal identity.

employmentTypeNormalized.title: Normalized explicit employment type
employmentTypeNormalized.description: Exact mapping of explicit employmentType/commitment labels only. Missing and ambiguous source labels stay unknown.

publishedAt.title: Source publication date
publishedAt.description: Unknown stays null. Greenhouse updated_at is never mapped here.

publishedAtMeaning.title: Publication date meaning
publishedAtMeaning.description: Ashby: last-published. Greenhouse first_published if present: first-published.

salary.title: Published compensation
salary.description: Only exposed source compensation; no salary estimates or currency conversion.
